info.title: Live Studio API
info.description:
API for managing live streaming studios, including host accounts, schedules, attendance, performance tracking, and Shopee e-commerce integration.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT Bearer token authentication. Obtain a token via `/api/auth/login`.

## Multi-Tenancy
This API supports multi-tenant isolation. Each user belongs to a tenant, and data is automatically filtered by tenant.

Get all hosts grouped by their studio

List which accounts belong to which hosts.

This is the bridge the performa endpoints use to decide whose numbers a live session belongs to. It replaces attendance for that purpose: attendance records who was present, which is a different question from who owns an account's results.

Assignments are historical — ending one keeps the row, so reports over past periods still resolve to whoever held the account at the time. Results are newest-first by `valid_from` and tenant-scoped.

parameters.name: studio
parameters.description: Filter by studio ID (joined through the account)

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Set to `true` to keep only assignments that have not been ended (`valid_to` is null)

post.description:
Assign an account to a host from a given moment.

**One account cannot be held by two hosts at once.** An overlapping assignment is rejected with `400`, naming the host that already holds it — a live session cannot belong to two people, so the ambiguity is blocked on write rather than guessed at read time. The same host holding an account across adjacent spans is fine.

`valid_from` defaults to **midnight today**, so assigning an account part-way through the day still counts that day's earlier sessions. If the account was released by another host later than that, the new assignment starts at the moment of release instead — a same-day handover therefore does not collide.

valid_from.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` or an RFC3339 timestamp. Defaults to midnight today.

valid_to.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` or an RFC3339 timestamp. Omit to leave the assignment open. Must be after `valid_from`.

400.description: Invalid dates, or the account is already held by another host in an overlapping period

example.details: account is held by host Budi for an overlapping period

put.description:
Patch an assignment. Every field is optional, so an assignment can be ended by sending `valid_to` alone.

**Ending an assignment is not the same as deleting it.** Ending sets `valid_to` and keeps the history, so past reports are unaffected; deleting removes the link entirely and therefore changes reports retroactively.

To end an assignment *now*, send an RFC3339 timestamp rather than a date — today's date parses to midnight, which can fall before the assignment started and is rejected as an invalid range.

Sending `valid_to: ""` reopens the assignment; omitting the field leaves it unchanged.

valid_to.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` or RFC3339. An empty string clears it, reopening the assignment.

400.description: `valid_to` is not after `valid_from`, or the change would overlap another host's assignment

delete.description:
Remove the assignment entirely.

⚠️ This **changes past reports**: sessions during that period stop being attributed to the host. To stop an assignment while keeping history intact, set `valid_to` via `PUT` instead.

get.description:
⚠️ **This is a WebSocket endpoint, not a plain GET.** Connect with `ws://`/`wss://`.

Streams the sessions that are **currently on air**, across every account in the tenant. An initial payload is sent on connect, then refreshed every 2–10 seconds.

**Authentication is via a `?token=<jwt>` query parameter**, not the `Authorization` header, because browsers cannot set headers on a WebSocket handshake.

**Keepalive required:** the server sets a 60s read deadline and never sends pings, so a client that stays silent is disconnected. Send any message every ~30s.

Only ongoing sessions appear. Shopee's realtime list also returns sessions that have already finished, and its `status` field reads 2 for both — so liveness is derived from `startTime + duration` tracking the present. `total` counts everything Shopee returned; `relive` counts what is actually live.

101.description: Switching Protocols — WebSocket established. Each frame is an array of accounts.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired `token` query parameter

get.description:
⚠️ **WebSocket endpoint.** Streams the realtime dashboard for one session — overview, viewer profile, viewer source, buyer profile and product list — refreshed every 3–8 seconds.

Authenticate with `?token=<jwt>` and send a keepalive every ~30s, as with `/live/preview`.

get.description:
Read persisted live sessions from the `lives` table.

**This never contacts Shopee** — it keeps working when an account's session cookie expires. Only `POST /live/history/sync` talks to Shopee; run that to refresh the table.

Results are newest-first and tenant-scoped. Use `/live/history/{id}` for a single account, or the `account` query parameter here.

parameters.name: studio
parameters.description: Filter by studio ID (joined through the account)

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the range, inclusive. Must be sent together with `endDate`.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the range, inclusive. Must be sent together with `startDate`.

post.summary: Sync Live History for All Accounts
post.description:
Fetch live-session history for every account in the tenant and persist it to the `lives` table.

**Idempotent** — sessions are matched on `session_id` and upserted, so re-running refreshes figures that settle after a stream ends (notably `confirmedSales`) rather than creating duplicates.

Accepts the same query parameters as `GET /live/shopee/history/{id}`; only sessions inside the `timeDim` window ending at `endDate` are synced, so backfilling older history means calling this repeatedly with earlier `endDate` values.

An account whose Shopee call fails (e.g. expired cookie) is reported in its own entry via `error` and skipped — one bad account does not fail the run.

example.message: synced live history for all accounts successfully

data.error: failed to do request to /supply/api/lm/sellercenter/liveList/v2: unauthorized

post.summary: Sync Live History for One Account
post.description:
Fetch live-session history for a single account and persist it to the `lives` table.

**Idempotent** — sessions are matched on `session_id` and upserted, so re-running refreshes settled figures instead of duplicating rows. Walks every page of the result set, not just the first.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Sessions fetched per upstream page while walking all pages

parameters.name: timeDim
parameters.description: Length of the window ending at `endDate`

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the window, defaults to today

500.description: Account not found, or Shopee rejected the request (e.g. expired cookie)

StoredLiveItem.description: One persisted live session, served from the lives table. Populated by POST /live/history/sync from Shopee's liveList/v2. Shopee sends JSON null for several metrics (views, peak_views, likes, followers_growth, product_clicks, conversion_rate, paid_orders, paid_sales); those persist as 0, so a 0 means 'not reported' rather than necessarily 'zero'. There is no end time — only start_time plus duration.

synced_at.description: When this row was last refreshed by a sync
